subject: Food Science
title: Cultured Meat
description: A micro-lesson that makes Cultured Meat usable.

hook.text: The first lab-grown burger cost $330,000 in 2013. By 2023, production costs fell below $10 per patty.

buildup.text: Cultured meat grows animal muscle cells in bioreactors fed with nutrients. Real animal cells, real meat protein.

discovery.text: A single cell sample can theoretically produce enough meat to feed the world for years.

twist.text: The biggest challenge isn't growing cells—it's creating structure. Ground meat is solved.

climax.text: Singapore approved cultured chicken for sale in 2020—the first country. The US followed in 2023.

punchline.text: Real meat, no animal. From $330,000 to $10 in a decade. Ground works. Steak is next.

quiz.question: What is the biggest challenge for cultured meat production?
options: Creating structured texture like steak with fat marbling—not just ground meat
